title: Road managers like Frenchie
summary: McRae explains the road manager handled office business and contracts, not the band, and names Frenchie on Armstrong's tour.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Where the band is gonna stay, what time you're gonna leave. You had a road manager, but see, the road manager wasn't there to take care of the band.
He was there to take care of the office business and work that contract out. See if everybody got paid, the office got their money -- everything.
Who was Louie's road manager, by the way?
He came over from Glaser. I think it was Frenchie -- came over from Moe Gale's office. He worked for a year with me.
How about Lionel, who was his road manager?

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
